topic: How can we break the current limit on energy-conversion efficiencies?
key_answer: There is no universal energy-conversion efficiency limit to break. A valid improvement changes a declared converter architecture and demonstrates a matched-boundary net gain after spectral, optical, thermal, electrical, auxiliary, uncertainty, stability, and transfer terms are reconciled. SPECTRA-Loop proposes a spectrally partitioned PV-TPV test architecture for this purpose.
